next_boundary.name: Controlled Year-End Close and Retained Earnings
recommended_sequence: require a complete financial year with governed accounting periods before year-end close
define whether every period must be hard closed before a year-end closing transaction can be prepared
derive the financial-year revenue/expense result from immutable journal evidence
create a controlled balanced closing journal that transfers revenue/expense balances to an explicitly mapped retained-earnings account
record exact year-end close provenance, authorisation and journal linkage
make correction/reopen additive through reversal or reopening evidence rather than mutating the closing journal
update Package 004N so unclosed earnings become retained earnings only after the controlled close journal takes effect
next_boundary.governing_rule: year-end close must consume governed journal/period evidence and create additive balanced accounting evidence; it must never rewrite prior journals or period history

open_product_gaps: General/direct contract creation remains absent; current formation is accepted-quotation-derived.
Accepted-quotation conversion edge case remains when the source estimate already has a project but conversion provenance is absent.
Year-end close and retained-earnings transfer are the next accounting boundary.
Statutory financial statements, provider integrations, bank reconciliation, purchase-ledger/AP and FX remain later boundaries.
